description: Source code for managing AOT (Ahead-Of-Time) kernel compilation and caching in PyTorch's inductor, specifically for eager execution. Contains class 'AOTIPythonKernelHolder' with methods for kernel cache management, kernel loading, and invocation.

classes.name: AOTIPythonKernelHolder
classes.description: Manages AOT kernel caching, loading, and execution for PyTorch inductor eager mode.

methods.name: AOTIPythonKernelHolder
methods.description: Constructor initializing kernel holder with dispatch key, namespace, and operator name.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the kernel, performing cache lookup and either cache hit or miss handling.

methods.name: cache_lookup
methods.description: Checks if a suitable cached kernel exists for given operator and arguments.

methods.name: cache_hit
methods.description: Executes the cached kernel and pushes outputs onto the stack.

methods.name: init_aoti_kernel_cache
methods.description: Loads and initializes AOTI kernels from Python cache.

methods.name: load_aoti_model_runner
methods.description: Loads the appropriate AOTI model container runner based on device type.

methods.name: cache_miss
methods.description: Handles cache miss by producing a new kernel, loading it, and executing.

methods.name: produce_aoti_kernel_lib
methods.description: Generates the kernel library path by invoking Python functions for AOT compilation.
